title: L-value criterion for congruent numbers
exact_target: For each congruent-number elliptic curve, does vanishing of its $L$-function at one exactly detect the existence of a rational right triangle of area $n$?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8900010 (AMR-088-0010). CC BY 4.0.
